opportunities.title: Research and Travel Grants (Research Awards)

deadlines.raw: 15 January annually (references 21 January) for Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, and Open Research
7 April annually (references 14 April) for Beatrice di Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered. Projects should not start before 1 April in the year of application and grants should be taken up by 31 December of the year awarded.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, with no period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions. Covers archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, history of collecting, and intellectual enquiry into the human past. Includes named awards (Marion Wilson, Joan Pye, Hugh Chapman).

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications made via the Grants Application Portal, selecting 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants'.
opportunities.summary: Church conservation grants with two application rounds per year (31 March and 31 August). Supports conservation of church fixtures, fittings and monuments. No references are required for these applications.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March and 31 August every year (application made via William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications made via the Grants Application Portal.
opportunities.summary: Textile conservation and research grants. Applications are submitted by selecting the 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants' option on the Grants Application Portal. No references are required.
